complete_examples.text: Comparing the rail displacement at different positions in the figure of time history, it can be seen that when the trains run on the circular curved track, the difference of rail lateral displacement between linear and nonlinear conditions is greater than that on the transition curve and straight line, which is due to the influence of curve curvature, and the variation of the maximum of rail displacement shown in Fig. 11 also proves this point.
